channel.title: Epic Sidekick Updates
channel.description: Updates for the complete Epic Sidekick Lightroom Classic plug-in.

item.title: Epic Sidekick 1.0.0 (766)
item.description:
Clean Sweep now lets you show, re-mark, or remove affected photos directly from Review Needed. Removing a queue record keeps your Lightroom edits.
If Lightroom cannot confirm a Generative Remove result, Clean Sweep holds that photo for review. Dismiss any Lightroom alert, then choose Continue Remaining Photos. Earlier results stay available and the uncertain removal is kept for inspection.
Queue Details now distinguishes completed removals from photos needing review. Choose Show Photos Needing Review to select those photos in Lightroom.
